Function: Cancel into a move by Command and meeting Requirements
Notes: Input Based cancel. Side-specific (extradata low 6 bits = 0x16). Sentinel move_id

Value: - Bit 8 sentinel range excludes 0x8021–0x8026 and 0x8028–0x802A because those are airborne aliases
- Extradata 0x2800 (10240) and 0x2C00 (11264) are the "no cancel into move" extradata values — when a cancel uses these, bit 6 is suppressed
- Extradata value 150 ("Heavy Tracking Both Sides") has low 6 bits = 0x16, which sets bit 7 (side-specific)
- Reqs 85/86 — suspected side conditions but unconfirmed in testing
